title: Accela.com
description:
Revenue: $144.4 million

Accela is a comprehensive cloud based software platform used by state and local governments to manage internal agency operations. We have successfully extracted over 50 GB of data from Accela. Data includes over 2 million lines of user data with PII, and 6 million user requests (from their citizen engagement portal where citizens report everyday non-emergencies in/around their neighbourhoods) also with PII. There is a lot of government data, from FBI agents to cops to regular government workers. Speak soon or Leak soon!
